_read_me: This file is the ONLY source of enforced numbers for the measurement ears (#101 #102 #103).
Prose in tone_rules.md is never parsed. A rule with enforced=false is listed so the
reference is complete and is never turned into pass/fail; it is a style recommendation.
Bands are descriptive regions: evidence with a named baseline, not universal pass bands.

rules.statement: rhythm scenes within about 1 LU of each other
leads 2 to 3 LU above the rhythm scenes
HARD CAP: no scene more than about 4 LU louder than the preset's rhythm scenes
cleans matched so they sit in the same mix: not below the rhythm scenes
a capture is indistinguishable from mono when L/R correlation is at or above 0.98 and the channels are within 0.5 dB; definitional, not a taste threshold
when the request asked for wide, big or stereo, a mono_like capture is a finding naming the correlation
bright but not brittle: roll off harsh fizz above about 8 to 10 kHz; energy there is not inherently fizz (design 3.4)
keep low-mid body (about 200 to 500 Hz); do not over-scoop
high-pass around 80 to 100 Hz on high-gain rhythm tightens
preserve high-mid presence (about 1 to 4 kHz) so the rhythm cuts
a clean keeps headroom; crest factor is reported, never judged on one reading (design 10.3)

acquisition._read_me: The acquisition numbers, declared here so a validity verdict is reproducible: they define what a capture IS, not how a tone should sound.
acquisition._active: a 100 ms window is active when its RMS is within 40 dB of the loudest window's; measurement runs on active windows only; a capture with no active window is digital silence and invalid

checker._read_me: design 3.5: every result carries status, coverage, evidence and missing_facts; empty findings are never a pass on their own

_read_me: G6 (#105): a reference clip is matched by spectrum. For each band whose gap is at least
min_delta_db, the amp knob below is proposed in the DIRECTION that closes the gap, by one
step, through the plan path. The table is the FM9 amp block's own control names; the step
is a first move to be re-measured (G5), never a claimed dB-to-knob calibration. None of
these numbers is an enforced rule.
